tool_args.rationale: Across the five paid rows, y/u_now is about 1.83 with very small scatter, while H, x_now, and mem_conv vary. A one-parameter proportional law is therefore the parsimonious fit; no available probe is needed. The supplied code fits the coefficient numerically.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Observed y/u_now is nearly constant across five rows despite variation in x_now, mem_conv, and H; another trajectory batch is not justified by the present evidence.
It is not relevant to the proportional present-input pattern and is explicitly discouraged.
Both predict a dependence on H, and cooling also predicts dependence on x_now; neither is supported by the observed ratios.
Its nonlinear dependence on u_now is not indicated by the nearly constant y/u_now ratios.
